title: The harness release candidate: every verify layer, broken alone
note: Killed in digests mode (no signature runtime needed): each layer beneath SHA256SUMS has a forgery consistent everywhere else (tests/test_supply_chain.py), so a deleted check cannot hide behind the one above it. Signature verification itself runs in the supply-chain workflow, with GitHub OIDC.

mutations.name: SC1_bytes_need_not_match_the_sums
mutations.rationale: an artifact whose bytes changed after signing verifies

mutations.name: SC2_the_sums_may_list_anything
mutations.rationale: SHA256SUMS can sign a different set of files from the one the release is

mutations.name: SC3_provenance_subjects_are_not_compared
mutations.rationale: the provenance can describe other bytes than the ones signed

mutations.name: SC4_the_source_commit_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: provenance and index can name different commits

mutations.name: SC5_the_index_digests_are_not_compared
mutations.rationale: the index can state a digest the signature never covered

mutations.name: SC6_the_sbom_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: an SBOM that adds or drops a locked package verifies

mutations.name: SC7_source_members_are_not_compared
mutations.rationale: source.zip can carry a file the commit does not have

mutations.name: SC8_the_manifest_digest_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: the index can name a manifest digest other than the archived manifest's

mutations.name: SC9_a_missing_signature_is_skipped
mutations.rationale: a required signature that is absent is not refused as absent

mutations.name: SC10_a_wildcard_policy_is_accepted
mutations.find: if not isinstance(v, str) or not v or "*" in v or "PENDING" in v:
mutations.replace: if not isinstance(v, str) or not v:
mutations.rationale: a wildcard signer identity verifies anyone's signature

mutations.name: SC11_any_issuer_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a signature from an identity provider other than GitHub Actions' verifies
